_doc: Endpoint-clean strand for canonical 3-point MACE. The primary PCSK9 page remains STALE for search_not_executed and its main pool intentionally includes broader published MACE definitions; this strand decomposes the canonical three-component evidence only.
why_topic_is_suppressed: Not suppressed. The strand is supplemental because the registered page already has a broader primary composite pool, and the search remains stale.

members.source: FOURIER (PMID 28304224) abstract reports the key secondary endpoint as cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, or stroke: 816 patients (5.9%) vs. 1013 patients (7.4%); hazard ratio, 0.80; 95% CI, 0.73 to 0.88; P<0.001.
members.selection_note: Key secondary endpoint; same canonical 3-point component set.

members.source: VESALIUS-CV (PMID 41211925) abstract: A total of 12,257 patients were randomly assigned to receive evolocumab (6129 patients) or placebo (6128) and were included in the efficacy analyses. A 3-point MACE event occurred in 336 patients (5-year Kaplan-Meier estimate, 6.2%) in the evolocumab group, as compared with 443 (8.0%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.75; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.65 to 0.86; P<0.001). A 4-point MACE event occurred in 747 patients (5-year Kaplan-Meier estimate, 13.4%) in the evolocumab group, as compared with 907 (16.2%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.81; 95% CI, 0.73 to 0.89; P<0.001).
members.selection_note: Selected prespecified co-primary by the 2026-09-16 component-set rule.

common_effect_sensitivity.note: Conventional common-effect sensitivity shown because k=2 HKSJ intervals are intentionally conservative.

pool.note_k2: Primary interval uses the registered PM+HKSJ engine; with k=2 the HKSJ t multiplier is large, so the common-effect sensitivity is displayed for context.

declared_absent.reason: Cached abstract reports a four-component composite including unstable-angina hospitalization; matching 3-point ODYSSEY OUTCOMES is not in the committed abstract.
